The '''Coruscant Energy Commission''' was a regulatory body that was responsible for oversight of energy recharge prices on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that followed the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], energy prices per [[parajoule]] on Coruscant rose on average by 50% a year, which allowed energy companies operating the world to earn vast profits and caused the members of the Commission became trillionaires.
